        tl = make_token_list(
            make_token(T.Keyword, 'SELECT'),
            make_token(T.Whitespace, ' '),
            make_token(T.Comment.Single, '-- foo'),
            make_token(T.Whitespace, ' '),
            make_token(T.Number.Integer, '1'),
        )
        result = StripCommentsFilter().process(tl)
